# BrowseJobs

> IBrowseJobs Technologies, Whitefield, Bengaluru. Data Engineering, Data Analytics, DevOps & Cloud, Python Backend, and Agentic AI courses, plus an AI interview product for employers. The syllabus is reverse-engineered from real interviews. Nobody can guarantee employment — the market decides.

## Courses

- [Data Engineering course](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/data-engineering): Pipelines, warehouses, and the modern data stack. Six months. ₹30,000 covers the course. The placement fee is due only after an offer is accepted.
- [Data Engineering in Bangalore](https://browsejobs.ai/data-engineering-course-bangalore): Whitefield classroom and live online.
- [Data Engineering in India](https://browsejobs.ai/data-engineering-course-india): The same six-month course, live online.
- [Data Analytics](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/data-analytics): Excel, SQL, Python, and Power BI. Six months. Pay after placement.
- [Data Analytics course in Bangalore](https://browsejobs.ai/data-analytics-course-bangalore): Whitefield classroom and live online.
- [Data Analytics course in India](https://browsejobs.ai/data-analytics-course-india): The same six-month course, live online.
- [Agentic AI course](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/agentic-ai-course): Python, large language models, RAG, and AI agents. Six months. ₹30,000 covers the course.
- [Agentic AI course in Bangalore](https://browsejobs.ai/agentic-ai-course-bangalore): Whitefield classroom and live online.
- [Agentic AI course in India](https://browsejobs.ai/agentic-ai-course-india): The same six-month course, live online.
- [Gen AI course in Bangalore](https://browsejobs.ai/gen-ai-course-bangalore): The Agentic AI syllabus. Canonical page is the Bangalore Agentic AI course.
- [Gen AI course in India](https://browsejobs.ai/gen-ai-course-india): The Agentic AI syllabus. Canonical page is the India Agentic AI course.
- [DevOps & Cloud](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/devops-cloud): Ship, scale, and run production systems.
- [Python Backend](https://browsejobs.ai/courses/python-backend): APIs, databases, and production Python.
- [All courses](https://browsejobs.ai/courses)
- [Free 5-day Python bootcamp](https://browsejobs.ai/free-python-bootcamp): Monday 19 October through Friday 23 October 2026, one hour each evening, live and online. Day 5 includes a mini project and the AI interview.

## Hiring product

- [AI interviews for employers](https://browsejobs.ai/employers): Structure a job description, rank candidates, run AI screening and interview rounds, and hand HR a written brief.
- [Open jobs](https://browsejobs.ai/jobs): Roles hiring through BrowseJobs, plus openings from the wider market.

## Fees

Three free steps come first: counselling with a written Career Analysis Report, a live masterclass, and a 7-hour Python bootcamp. Registration is ₹30,000 after those steps, and it covers the course. The placement fee is three months of the CTC on the offer the student accepts, charged in EMIs only after that acceptance. 30-day money-back guarantee, any reason, in writing. Nobody can guarantee employment.

A score of 75% or above on the AI interview sends the CV to 3,000 HR recruiters and, on BrowseJobs internal data, comes with an almost 60% higher chance of an interview call. Below 75%, the next step is a free counselling roadmap. A person always releases the offer.

## Answers

Short pages written so an answer can be quoted. Each one starts with the answer.

- [Answers](https://browsejobs.ai/answers): Hub of the direct answers below.
- [Best data engineering course in India](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/best-data-engineering-course-in-india): No fake ranking. How to choose, and what the six-month live online course actually is.
- [How can a non-IT person become a data engineer](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/how-can-a-non-it-person-become-a-data-engineer): Free AI interview, then a score, then a course only if you still need one.
- [AI interview platform for hiring in India](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/ai-interview-platform-for-hiring-in-india): Disclosed screening call, proctored rounds, written brief. A person releases the offer.
- [AI hiring tool to shortlist candidates automatically](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/ai-hiring-tool-to-shortlist-candidates-automatically): Ranked shortlist with a written reason. Rules you set can move someone forward. The tool does not reject or hire on its own.
- [Best data engineering course in Bangalore](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/best-data-engineering-course-in-bangalore): How to choose in Bengaluru. Live online course, Whitefield office, fees in writing.
- [Is pay after placement real?](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/is-pay-after-placement-real): ₹30,000 registration covers the course. Placement fee only after an accepted offer.
- [What is an AI interview, and how does the score work?](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/what-is-an-ai-interview): 15 questions from your CV, a score out of 100, and when employers can see your profile.
- [How long does it take to become a data engineer?](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/how-long-to-become-a-data-engineer): The course is six months. That is not a hire date.
- [Best Agentic AI course in India](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/best-agentic-ai-course-in-india): How to choose. Python, LLMs, RAG, and AI agents. Six months. ₹30,000 covers the course.
- [Best Gen AI course in Bangalore](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/best-gen-ai-course-in-bangalore): The Gen AI page teaches the Agentic AI syllabus. Canonical city page is Agentic AI in Bangalore.
- [Best data analytics course in Bangalore](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/best-data-analytics-course-in-bangalore): How to choose in the city. Six months. Pay after placement.
- [Best data analyst course in India](https://browsejobs.ai/answers/best-data-analyst-course-in-india): The same Data Analytics course, live online across India.
